$comment: IA of the local React clone in this folder (src/App.jsx). Structure measured from the live original (https://www.thrivelearning.com/) via CLONE_SPEC.md and pixel-audited; copy in the clone is original placeholder text (brand 'Nimbus', assistant 'Nova'). The clone's nav/footer links are '#' stubs, so only one route exists.

categories.SHELL: Site chrome present on every route: fixed navigation and footer.
categories.PROOF: Social proof: customer logos, outcome stats, testimonials, case studies.
categories.PRODUCT: Product explanation modules: feature tabs, AI assistant, capability slider.
categories.STORY: Editorial brand moments: statement copy, scroll-driven quote, brand video.
categories.CONVERSION: Blocks whose job is to capture a demo request or answer pre-sale objections.

shell.nav.description: Fixed, transparent top bar: wordmark, centred pill of hover-open dropdown menus (300ms close delay), AI 'Ask' link, primary 'Book a demo' button; collapses to a full-screen menu at <=991px.

hero.split-visual.description: Two-column hero: avatar row + trust line, serif H1, subtitle, three review badges, primary + dark buttons on the left; a 1440:1089 product collage bleeding past the right viewport edge. Load-time staggered blur/skew reveal.

proof.logo-row.description: Static (non-scrolling) row of six customer logos under a one-line caption; wraps to a grid on mobile.
proof.logo-row.scope: Directly under the hero on the 1 route.

product.feature-tabs.description: Section H2 plus four click-driven accordion-style tab rows on the left; matching 670:600 product screenshot fades (.3s) in a pane that bleeds off the right edge. No autoplay.

product.assistant-tabs.description: AI-assistant intro header followed by five persona tab buttons driving a looping, draggable slide track (800ms ease); each slide pairs title + copy with a square animation slot.

product.capability-slider.description: Three-up looping slider of six enterprise capability cards (image + highlighted lead phrase + grey body); autoplays every 3s once 40% visible, with widening progress bullets and a play/pause button.

proof.results-stats.description: Centred H2 over a 4-column grid of dark stat cards (customer logo, large stat, grey sentence with inline brand link); 2 columns at <=991px, 1 at <=479px.
proof.results-stats.scope: On the 1 route, immediately followed by proof.testimonial in the same container.

proof.testimonial.description: Single large pull quote with 80px avatar, name and role/company line, centred under the stats grid.

story.zoom-statement.description: Full-bleed 1440:598 image that scroll-scrubs from 2.5x/transparent to 1x/opaque, followed by a centred serif H2 and multi-line grey statement paragraph.

story.scroll-quote.description: Short analyst-style quote whose letters scroll-scrub from near-black to white one by one; the page's only ScrollTrigger-driven text effect.

proof.case-study-carousel.description: Header (H2 + button left, paragraph right) over a centred, looping carousel of five case-study cards (photo with brand logo, title, two stats); centre card scaled 1.1, neighbours at 20% opacity; 4s autoplay paused on hover.

story.brand-video.description: H2 and intro paragraph above a 16:9 video slot with play button (static placeholder; the original embeds YouTube), with a closing paragraph below.

conversion.faq.description: FAQ H2 with five independently toggling accordion items (open 450ms / close 650ms outQuart, plus-icon rotation).

conversion.demo-form.description: Demo-request block at the top of the footer: heading and copy beside a 300px form (static placeholder standing in for the original HubSpot embed).
conversion.demo-form.scope: Opens the footer on the 1 route.

shell.footer.description: Dark rounded footer card: 'ask an AI' icon row, wordmark + socials, four link columns, rating and award badges, compliance line and legal drop-up menus.
